LanguageData.RHA_X11_NeedHome: A player home with free colonists is required.

LanguageData.RHA_X11_TravelHelp: Send a caravan to the ruin on the world map and enter the site. Carry the loot home with the caravan. You can return later and continue your progress.

LanguageData.RHA_X11_NeedOperator: Choose an able free colonist on the ruin map who can manipulate equipment.

LanguageData.RHA_X11_NoGuardFaction: No mechanoid faction is available in this world.

LanguageData.RHA_X11_Guards: {0} guards can still fight. Defeat them to resolve this encounter.
LanguageData.RHA_X11_ArrivalHelp: Select a ruin facility and open Inspect facility. Choose a colonist and an action; they will walk to the device to carry it out.
LanguageData.RHA_X11_Overview: Survey a chosen ruin type for 150 shards at difficulty T1–T6, once every 15 days. Keep up to 3 sites active. Each ruin has 4 branching encounters, with supply rewards multiplied by its tier. Preserve at least 2 installations to choose one relic type and receive one copy per tier; a damaged cache yields 50 gold per tier. From T4, guards can also gain cards or prismatic equipment.
LanguageData.RHA_X11_TierRewards: T{0} rewards: encounter supplies ×{0}; an intact cache grants {0} copies of one chosen relic; a damaged cache grants {1} gold.
LanguageData.RHA_X11_SurveyConfirm: Survey {0} at difficulty T{1} for {2} shards? A successful survey starts the 15-day cooldown.
LanguageData.RHA_X11_AwaitCaravan: No party has arrived. Prepare colonists, food and repair supplies before travelling.
LanguageData.RHA_X11_SupplyHelp: Supplies come from the party inventory on this map, or visible, unforbidden items within 8 cells of the facility with line of sight. Requirements are rechecked when work finishes; costs are paid once.
LanguageData.RHA_X11_GuardPreview: Wakes {0} guardians with {1} times native body health
LanguageData.RHA_X11_GuardBlocked: The guard exit is blocked. Clear space around the facility and try again. No supplies were spent.
LanguageData.RHA_X11_CachePreview: Sealed equipment: preserve at least 2 installations and resolve all 4 facilities to choose one relic type, receiving one copy per difficulty tier.
LanguageData.RHA_X11_LosesInsight: This installation is stripped and does not count as preserved.
LanguageData.RHA_X11_ChooseRelic: The equipment is intact. Choose one relic type and receive one copy per difficulty tier. The operator will open its case at the final facility.
LanguageData.RHA_X11_DamagedCache: Fewer than 2 installations were preserved. The delicate relics are damaged, but 50 gold per risk level can still be recovered.
LanguageData.RHA_X11_BringLootHome: The cache is open. Include the loot when reforming your caravan. When you no longer intend to return, abandon this site to free its slot.
LanguageData.RHA_X11_AbandonConfirm: Abandon this ruin? Its map, uncollected items and expedition progress will be removed. You cannot abandon a map with remaining player pawns or protected buildings.
LanguageData.RHA_X11_PeopleRemain: Pawns, protected buildings or incoming transporters still prevent abandonment.
LanguageData.RHA_X11_Changed: Conditions changed before completion. This action was not resolved.
